title: Agricultural Businesses Energy Incentive Program
overview: The Agricultural Businesses Energy Incentive Program offers matching grants to accelerate the implementation of energy efficiency and renewable energy on farms and other agriculture-related entities. The goal is to support innovative technologies to reduce onsite energy use, reduce climate impacts, improve energy efficiency, increase onsite renewable generation, improve resiliency, and support the economic vitality of agricultural businesses in Michigan.Eligible applicants include any agricultural or related entity (farm, crop processing, food processing, etc.) or organizations that provide assistance/services to these entities, provided they have less than 500 employees worldwide and are physically located in Michigan. Cannabis facilities and municipalities are ineligible.Eligible projects must address program objectives and priorities, such as high efficiency HVAC, insulation, efficient lighting, solar panels, and wind turbines. Impacted facilities must be occupied and have long-range plans of continued use.The application process requires submitting an Online Application along with an Approved Budget Form, Detailed Timeline, Organizational Charts, and other required attachments. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until all funds are allocated or by August 30, 2027. Show More
